# s05 — Add quire default to set or clear the default profile

There is no CLI to choose the default profile; the docs say to edit config.toml by hand.

**Findings:** G3 · **Size:** M · **Tree:** install

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Registration deliberately leaves `default` unchanged, so choosing a default
always means hand-editing TOML.

## Files

- `install.py` (`set_default`, `cmd_default`)
- `quire.py` (`main` subcommand dispatch)
- `test_quire.py`
- `README.md`, `docs/profiles.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`

## Failing tests

- `quire default acme` sets `default = "acme"` and keeps the profiles and comments.
- `quire default --clear` sets `default = ""`.
- An unknown name errors, and the file is unchanged.

## Implement

Add `set_default(text, name)` in the style of `upsert_profile`. It edits the
top-level `default =` line or inserts one before the first table, re-parses
with `tomllib`, compares against the expected dict, and leaves the file
unchanged on mismatch. Add `cmd_default` with `--config-dir` and `--clear`, and
dispatch `default` in `quire.main` next to `install`/`configs`. Document that
the subcommand shadows a built-in named `default`.

## Check

- `python3 test_quire.py`
- Manual run with `--config-dir` in a scratch directory; never the real config.
